claims.statement: EU countries designate notified bodies to perform legally required third-party product conformity assessment.
The Commission's NANDO listings identify each notified body and the tasks for which it is notified, and manufacturers may choose any legally designated body with the right scope.

economics.acquisition_route: Partner with independent testing labs and product consultancies that encounter blocked clients
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Unvalidated: 2000 annual EU engagements at 4000 PLN net revenue could reach 8m PLN revenue and over 5m PLN founder equity in years 5-8
economics.pricing: Unvalidated: 2000-6000 PLN readiness fee plus 3-6% of completed assessment value
economics.retention_or_repeat: Manufacturers return for new models, surveillance and additional directives

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Private response-time, acceptance and lead-time data layered on NANDO becomes the best routing dataset
fingerprint.customer: Polish/EU manufacturers whose products require third-party conformity assessment
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Testing labs, product-design firms, accelerators and sector associations
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Scope-aware matching, availability requests, anonymized pre-screening and reusable technical-file completeness checks
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Manufacturer pays readiness and reservation fees when a notified body accepts the engagement
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A product launch is blocked because the manufacturer cannot secure an appropriately scoped assessment slot

structure.control_point: live assessment availability mapped to legally notified scope
structure.critical_dependency: Notified bodies must participate without compromising independence or non-discrimination

thesis: Help EU hardware SMEs find and reserve legally scoped notified-body conformity-assessment capacity, using NANDO scope data and standardized readiness packets.
title: Notified-Body Audit Slot Exchange
uncertainties: Actual slot scarcity, conversion and pricing are unvalidated
The best initial product legislation is unknown
